title: dryopteris costularis
intro: Dryopteris costularis, commonly known as the Chinese leather fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its multiple health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris costularis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
